say:1:1525416001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>? What brings you back all of a sudden?
say:1:1525416001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>? What brings you back all of a sudden?
say:1:1525416001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>? What brings you back all of a sudden?

choice_prompt:2:1525416001.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>? What brings you back all of a sudden?
choice_prompt:2:1525416001.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>? What brings you back all of a sudden?
choice_prompt:2:1525416001.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>? What brings you back all of a sudden?

say:3:1525416002:0.text: The Arcane Council's planning on killing another god?
say:3:1525416002:0.source_cn: 你们魔法师协会又准备弑神？

say:5:1525416003:0.text: You think I want to? We're just doing it to save you lot and Halia.
say:5:1525416003:0.source_cn: 你以为我很想？还不是为了救你们和呼临。

say:7:1525416004:0.text: Ah... Even the Wildborn are feeling the effects of the fallen god's power.
say:7:1525416004:0.source_cn: 没错……如今连雅库伯尔都受到了神堕之力的波及。

say:8:1525416006:0.text: Ever since that fallen god returned, the fields at Mirehold have been swarmed by locusts. There are so many of them, and we can't fight them off on our own.
say:8:1525416006:0.source_cn: 那曾受人类信仰的堕神回归后，水泽营地的麦田每日都会受到...

say:9:1525416007:0.text: If it weren't for these blasted locusts, I was about to ask Nazrik about getting help from the Arcane Council.
say:9:1525416007:0.source_cn: 若非针蝗突袭，老朽也正准备和那非商议向魔法师协会求援之事。

say:10:1525416008:0.text: ... We can't just keep swatting away the locusts forever. We need a long-term solution.
say:10:1525416008:0.source_cn: ……一味抵抗这些受堕神驱使的针蝗，的确不是长久之计。

say:12:1525416009:1.text: Good. Looks like you've got more sense than Kordan, at least.
say:12:1525416009:1.source_cn: 很好，看来你们比戈丹更有自知之明。

say:13:1525416010:1.text: I brought <style="stress"><player_name></style> back with one purpose: to wipe that fallen god off the face of this world.
say:13:1525416010:1.male: I brought <style="stress"><player_name></style> back with one purpose: to wipe that fallen god off the face of this world.
say:13:1525416010:1.female: I brought <style="stress"><player_name></style> back with one purpose: to wipe that fallen god off the face of this world.

say:14:1525416011:1.text: But I'll be honest, just the two of us won't be enough.
say:14:1525416011:1.source_cn: 不过，只靠我们两人的力量恐怕不够。

say:15:1525416012:1.text: You want me to help out?

say:16:1525416013:1.text: You're right. The Hunting Goddess may have fallen, but the power she gave you still has a use against the God of Harvest.
say:16:1525416013:1.source_cn: 嗯哼。虽然狩猎神陨落了，但她赐给你的力量还可以用来对付...

say:19:1525416015:0.text: Nazrik, you might need to run this by Kordan first...
say:19:1525416015:0.source_cn: 那非，这件事可能需要向戈丹汇报……

say:22:1525416017:0.text: We've never seen eye to eye.
say:22:1525416017:0.source_cn: 我和他本来就互相看不顺眼。
say:22:1525416017:0.male: We've never seen eye to eye.
say:22:1525416017:0.female: We've never seen eye to eye.

say:23:1525416019:1.text: Do you already know where he is?
say:23:1525416019:1.source_cn: 你们已经弄清楚丰饶神的所在了？

say:25:1525416020:1.text: He's somewhere deep in <style="highlight">the ruins of Tuttleton</style>, but I can't be sure of his exact location.

say:26:1525416021:1.text: Even a fox has more than one den, let alone a treacherous god.
say:26:1525416021:1.source_cn: 狡兔尚且三窟，何况是一位奸诈的堕神。

say:28:1525416023:0.text: I know you're itching for a fight with a god, but even with you, the three of us still wouldn't stand a chance against that old skeleton.
say:28:1525416023:0.source_cn: 我知道你对弑神这件事很感兴趣，但就算加上你，我们三个人...

say:29:1525416024:0.text: Like last time, if we want to draw him out and weaken his power, we'll need the light device at the Harvest Altar to burn through the darkness over Tuttleton.
say:29:1525416024:0.source_cn: 和之前一样，想要逼丰饶神现身，削弱他的神力，必须利用丰...

say:30:1525416025:0.text: His power's grown since last time. That little device alone won't be enough to hurt him.
say:30:1525416025:0.source_cn: 但是丰饶神的力量变强了，只凭那个小装置，恐怕不足以对他...

say:31:1525416026:0.text: That's why we need to <style="highlight">create more and stronger light sources</style>.
say:31:1525416026:0.source_cn: 所以要<style=highlight>制造更强更多的...

say:32:1525416027:0.text: I've got that part covered. You and <style="stress"><player_name></style> just focus on <style="highlight">keeping your people and the Halian folks safe</style>.
say:32:1525416027:0.source_cn: 这件事我会去办，不用你担心。你和<style=stre...
say:32:1525416027:0.male: I've got that part covered. You and <style="stress"><player_name></style> just focus on <style="highlight">keeping your people and the Halian folks safe</style>.
say:32:1525416027:0.female: I've got that part covered. You and <style="stress"><player_name></style> just focus on <style="highlight">keeping your people and the Halian folks safe</style>.

choice_prompt:33:1525416027.source_cn: 这件事我会去办，不用你担心。你和<style=stress><player_name></style>要做的就是在这段时间里<style=highlight>保护好你的同胞，还有呼临人</style>。
choice_prompt:33:1525416027.male: I've got that part covered. You and <style="stress"><player_name></style> just focus on <style="highlight">keeping your people and the Halian folks safe</style>.
choice_prompt:33:1525416027.female: I've got that part covered. You and <style="stress"><player_name></style> just focus on <style="highlight">keeping your people and the Halian folks safe</style>.

say:34:1525416028:0.text: Don't think this will be easy. After all, the only ones capable of handling this chaos are you and your horned friend here. Oh, and that rabbit elder, I guess, can serve as backup—though barely.
say:34:1525416028:0.source_cn: 别把事情想得太轻松了，毕竟真正有能力抵御混乱的人只有你...
say:34:1525416028:0.male: Don't think this will be easy. After all, the only ones capable of handling this chaos are you and your horned friend here. Oh, and that rabbit elder, I guess, can serve as backup—though barely.
say:34:1525416028:0.female: Don't think this will be easy. After all, the only ones capable of handling this chaos are you and your horned friend here. Oh, and that rabbit elder, I guess, can serve as backup—though barely.

say:35:1525416029:0.text: And forget about Halia. They have no one useful left.
say:35:1525416029:0.source_cn: 至于呼临城，更不要指望了。他们没有可用之人。
say:35:1525416029:0.male: And forget about Halia. They have no one useful left.
say:35:1525416029:0.female: And forget about Halia. They have no one useful left.

say:36:1525416031:0.text: Even if you hadn't said anything, I'd still be watching over the Wildborn.
say:36:1525416031:0.source_cn: 即使你不说，我也会保护雅库伯尔。

say:37:1525416032:0.text: Keep that fire going until the day the God of Harvest falls. Don't let the black mist swallow this land.
say:37:1525416032:0.source_cn: 那就保持这种劲头，直到丰饶神陨落的那天吧。千万别让黑雾...

choice:33:1:2.text: Thanks for not making me do all the work?
choice:33:1:2.source_cn: 我是不是该感谢你没让我一个人当苦力？
choice:33:1:2.male: Thanks for not making me do all the work?
choice:33:1:2.female: Thanks for not making me do all the work?

choice:21:0:1.text: You two back to fighting again?
choice:21:0:1.male: You two back to fighting again?
choice:21:0:1.female: You two back to fighting again?

choice:21:1:2.text: Yeah, not for something so trivial.
choice:21:1:2.male: Yeah, not for something so trivial.
choice:21:1:2.female: Yeah, not for something so trivial.

choice:2:0:1.text: To take care of the God of Harvest.
choice:2:0:1.male: To take care of the God of Harvest.
choice:2:0:1.female: To take care of the God of Harvest.

say:42:1525416005:1.text: Heh, probably to deal with the current crisis.
say:42:1525416005:1.source_cn: 呵呵，想必是为了解决眼下的危机。
